site_name: Wood Wharf RM02A, (Development Plots H1, H3, H4 and part of plot H2) Prestons Road, London E14
description: Application for Non-Material amendment to planning permission ref: PA/17/01344, Dated 22/11/2017.Non Material amendment(s) Sought:  Landscape changes adjacent to Lovegrove Walk, including the replacement of tree planters with VMS planters, addition of a tree pit, the relocation of a lamp post, the relocation of a number of bicycle racks.Highway changes adjacent to Lovegrove Walk, including the installation of a number of retractable and fixed bollards, updates to the kerb line, addition of an electric car parking point, updates to the crossing and updates on the road markingAmendments to the on-street parking layout, including the removal of an on-street parking bay to the west of Harbord Square and its relocation to the north-east of Harbord Square.
